in_marathi.name: Anirudh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The One Who Can't Be Overpowered
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anirudh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anirudh is a popular Hindu name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'aniruddha', meaning 'the one who can't be overpowered'.
